edu_clean <- edu_index |>
    select(-all_of(as.character(1870:1989)))

shared_years <- intersect(
  names(edu_clean)[grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", names(edu_clean))],
  names(internet)[grepl("^[0-9]{4}$", names(internet))]
)

edu_long <- edu_clean |>
  select(iso3 = geo, all_of(shared_years)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(shared_years),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "education_index"
  ) |>
  mutate(iso3 = toupper(iso3), year = as.integer(year)) |>
  select(iso3, year, education_index)

internet_long <- internet |>
  select(iso3 = geo, all_of(shared_years)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(shared_years),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "internet_users"
  ) |>
  mutate(iso3 = toupper(iso3), year = as.integer(year)) |>
  select(iso3, year, internet_users)

joined_data <- map |>
  mutate(
    iso3 = ISO3166.1.Alpha.3,
    join_key = 1L
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    tibble(year = as.integer(shared_years), join_key = 1L),
    by = "join_key",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  select(-join_key) |>
  left_join(edu_long, by = c("iso3", "year")) |>
  left_join(internet_long, by = c("iso3", "year"))

edu_map <- joined_data |>
  filter(year == 1990) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = education_index)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Education Index (1990)", na.value = "grey90")

edu_map
internet_map <- joined_data |>
  filter(year == 1990) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = internet_users)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Internet users (% of population, 1990)",
    na.value = "grey90"
  )

internet_map
scatter_data <- joined_data |>
  filter(!is.na(education_index), !is.na(internet_users)) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

plot_ly(
  scatter_data,
  x = ~education_index,
  y = ~internet_users,
  text = ~name,
  frame = ~year,
  ids = ~iso3,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 9, opacity = 0.75, color = "steelblue"),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "Country: %{text}<br>",
    "Education Index: %{x:.3f}<br>",
    "Internet users: %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>"
  )
) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Education Index"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Internet users (% of population)")
  ) |>
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: "))
